system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Logging sink that exports logs from a project to a BigQuery dataset for long-term analysis.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: logging_sink.jinja

resources:
- name: log-analytics-dataset
  type: bigquery.v2.dataset
  properties:
    datasetReference:
      datasetId: log_analytics_longterm
      projectId: $(ref.project.projectId)
    location: US
    description: "Long-term log analytics dataset populated by Cloud Logging sink"
    defaultTableExpirationMs: 31536000000
    labels:
      environment: production
      managed-by: deployment-manager
      purpose: log-analytics
    access:
    - role: OWNER
      specialGroup: projectOwners
    - role: READER
      specialGroup: projectReaders
    - role: WRITER
      specialGroup: projectWriters

- name: project-logging-sink
  type: gcp-types/logging-v2:projects.sinks
  properties:
    sink: bq-longterm-analytics-sink
    parent: projects/[PROJECT_ID]
    uniqueWriterIdentity: true
    destination: bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/[PROJECT_ID]/datasets/log_analytics_longterm
    description: "Exports all project logs to BigQuery for long-term analytics and compliance"
    filter: |
      severity >= DEFAULT
      AND NOT protoPayload.serviceName="logging.googleapis.com"
    bigqueryOptions:
      usePartitionedTables: true
    exclusions:
    - name: exclude-debug-logs
      description: "Exclude verbose debug logs to reduce storage costs"
      filter: severity < INFO
      disabled: false
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - log-analytics-dataset

- name: sink-writer-bq-dataeditor-binding
  action: gcp-types/bigquery-v2:bigquery.datasets.patch
  properties:
    projectId: [PROJECT_ID]
    datasetId: log_analytics_longterm
    access:
    - role: OWNER
      specialGroup: projectOwners
    - role: READER
      specialGroup: projectReaders
    - role: WRITER
      specialGroup: projectWriters
    - role: WRITER
      userByEmail: $(ref.project-logging-sink.writerIdentity)
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - project-logging-sink
    - log-analytics-dataset

outputs:
- name: sinkWriterIdentity
  value: $(ref.project-logging-sink.writerIdentity)
- name: sinkDestination
  value: $(ref.project-logging-sink.destination)
- name: bigqueryDatasetId
  value: log_analytics_longterm
